thread:
support-jen: Heads up — we started getting a spike of 502/504s hitting the hosted API edge around ~09:10 UTC. Multiple customer escalations (streaming timeouts + immediate 502s). Seeing higher retry rates in support logs. sample trace id: trace=abc12345 -> upstream returned 502. Anyone oncall?

oncall-eric: I'm on. Can you paste a quick repro or curl that a customer used?

support-jen:
```
curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-small","prompt":"hello"}' \n  https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
```
Response is immediate: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway

sre-maria: Looking at the edge dashboards now — envoy x-edge shows 502 rate ~8x baseline starting at 09:09:50. Upstream cluster for auth-cache shows 503/502 spikes and a lot of RST_STREAMs. Health checks to auth-cache look green though.

eng-josh: No infra deploys in the last 24h pushed to edge. Could this be connection pooling exhaustion from long-lived streaming requests (we've had a couple heavy embed/stream customers)?

eng-kevin: Checking auth-cache logs: repeated messages: "heartbeat mismatch: expected=2026-03-17T09:09:41Z got=2026-03-17T09:09:41.5Z for instance token-rotate" and then immediate connection close. h2 keepalive counters show ~2k resets around the same time.

eng-kevin: My suspicion: a config drift changed the pool eviction window to 500ms while heartbeats are 1s, leading to auth-cache instances being removed mid-handshake -> envoy returns 502.

oncall-eric: Good theory. Can we flip a fallback route to auth-cache-v2 to reduce impact while we validate?

deploy-bot: Started canary rollout of auth-cache-v2 in us-west-2 (cfg id cfg-90321). Monitoring.

support-jen: Customer retries show improved success after the canary started. Some are still hitting errors though.

eng-kevin: I'm applying a hotfix to increase pool evict to 2s and to ignore transient heartbeat jitter. Patch PR incoming. Also increasing upstream_conn_limit for the a/b pool to reduce churn.

sre-maria: After switching traffic to auth-cache-v2 the 502 rate dropped to baseline within ~3 minutes. Post-switch chart: 502s back to normal. We'll keep canary traffic until morning.

product-liz: We should prepare a short customer status note. ETA on final fix and RCA?

eng-josh: RCA + patch PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4321 — includes fix + load test to reproduce with long streaming sessions.

eng-kevin: Follow-up actions: (1) merge patch to make eviction > heartbeat, (2) add alert for bursty keepalive RST_STREAMs, (3) increase default upstream_conn_limit, (4) run targeted long-stream load tests against edge.

support-jen: I'll draft comms and ping legal if needed for the few enterprise customers that escalated. Thanks for the quick triage.

sre-maria: Filing incident ticket + postmortem doc. Preliminary impact: ~12 customers saw transient 502s, majority retried successfully after 1-2 attempts.

support-jen: Closing thread after comms sent and postmortem published. :thumbsup:
